text:
Caroline: Dropped the updated weekly KPI dashboard into the channel — flagging an attribution delta between GA4 last-click and our internal lead router. https://redwood.app/dashboards/kpi-weekly :eyes:
Eli: Saw that too. GA4 shows ~18% more leads w/utm_source=twitter vs our CRM. Might be double-counting or a redirect strip.
Maya: Do we have a holdout cohort to validate conversion differences? Also worth checking campaign tagging consistency across pages.
Samir: I'll run a quick join on raw_clicks -> form_submissions to see where utm disappears. If it's redirect-related we should be able to spot missing utm in referer header.
growth-bot: Weekly KPI summary posted — total leads: 2,134 (+6% WoW); demo requests: 412 (+3%). See: https://redwood.app/reports/weekly-kpi (automated)
Caroline: thx. Can you also add a breakdown by landing page and by referral path? want to know if a specific origin is inflated.
Samir: On it. Quick SQL I'll run and then add as a widget:
```
SELECT lp, utm_source, count(*) AS leads
FROM events.form_submit
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY lp, utm_source
ORDER BY leads DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Maya: If the utm is getting lost on redirect, adding a small client-side persist to localStorage + append on final submit should fix short term. We can push a small change to landing pages.
Eli: Also check our Inbound Lead Router rules — I've seen instances where certain UTM variants map to the same campaign but different tagging in GA4. That creates mismatch.
Caroline: Plan: Samir to add landing-page widget + run cohort diff by EOD. Maya to propose small client-side patch by Friday. Eli to audit router mapping and list suspicious UTMs. We'll reconvene tomorrow 9:15am PT for 15m. :calendar:
Samir: Will post query results and updated widget here when ready.
Maya: noted. I can draft the patch PR and a quick test plan.
Eli: I'll export router mapping and share a cleaned mapping doc.
Caroline: Awesome. If we find a systemic tagging issue we may need to retroactively reassign leads in the CRM. Heads up to CS for potential outreach.
Samir: Results posted: summary shows majority of delta comes from /lp/redwood-start (utm_source blank on 12% of submissions). Widget added: https://redwood.app/dashboards/kpi-weekly#widget-7
Caroline: Good sleuthing. Action items assigned. Closing thread for now — ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
